issues.title: [Feature][Performance] Support InternLM2-20B-Chat and dispatch scaled RoPE variants to the NPU kernel
issues.body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

`InternLM2ForCausalLM` runs on the existing upstream vLLM path, but its checkpoint sets `rope_scaling = {"type": "dynamic", "factor": 2.0}`, which resolves to `DynamicNTKScalingRotaryEmbedding`. That class was missing from `REGISTERED_ASCEND_OPS`, so every decoder layer silently fell back to `forward_native` — no log line, no error, just slower.

The same gap affects three other scaled RoPE types. They all share a property: the only thing they change is how the cos/sin cache is computed at init; the forward itself is inherited from `RotaryEmbedding`. So a single mixin (`_AscendScaledRopeMixin`) can route them all to the fused NPU kernel safely:

| `rope_scaling.type` | upstream class | models | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dynamic` + `factor` | `DynamicNTKScalingRotaryEmbedding` | InternLM2, InternLM2.5 | `forward_native` | NPU kernel |
| `dynamic` + `alpha` | `DynamicNTKAlphaRotaryEmbedding` | Hunyuan | `forward_native` | NPU kernel |
| `ntk` | `NTKScalingRotaryEmbedding` | — | `forward_native` | NPU kernel |
| `llama3` | `Llama3RotaryEmbedding` | Llama 3.1+ | `forward_native` | NPU kernel |

Three variants are intentionally left out:

- `longrope` / `fope`: they override the forward, not just the cache.
- `linear`: indexes into the cache via the `offsets` arg, which `rope_forward_oot` rejects. Registering it would break multi-LoRA serving.

Dispatch verified on Atlas A2 — each config built through `get_rope`, class printed, excluded types confirmed still on `forward_native`.

**Throughput** (2 × Atlas A2, TP=2, 1024/128, 64 prompts, concurrency 8):

|  | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| req/s | 1.70 | **1.96 (+15.4%)** |
| output tok/s | 216.97 | **250.42** |
| mean TPOT | 33.62 ms | **28.94 ms (−13.9%)** |
| mean TTFT | 435.8 ms | **401.7 ms** |

**Numeric accuracy** (bf16 vs fp32 reference, max abs error on rotated query). The NPU kernel is at least as close as `forward_native` in all cases:

| variant | len | NPU kernel | `forward_native` |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| dynamic/factor | 128 | 1.614e-02 | 2.196e-02 |
| dynamic/factor | 2048 | 2.590e-02 | 2.590e-02 |
| dynamic/alpha | 128 | 1.500e-02 | 2.193e-02 |
| dynamic/alpha | 2048 | 2.222e-02 | 3.095e-02 |
| ntk | 128 | 1.548e-02 | 2.041e-02 |
| ntk | 2048 | 1.776e-02 | 3.300e-02 |
| llama3 | 128 | 1.440e-02 | 2.122e-02 |
| llama3 | 2048 | 1.921e-02 | 3.058e-02 |

Also ships the full InternLM2-20B-Chat package: E2E accuracy config, nightly group entry, weight download entry, two-card serving tests, deployment tutorial, and supported-models row.

Closes #10673
Related to #9079

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Checkpoints with `rope_scaling.type` = `dynamic`, `ntk`, or `llama3` now hit the NPU kernel instead of the reference path. InternLM2-20B-Chat is added to the docs and nightly accuracy suite. Release note fragment included.

### How was this patch tested?

**Environment:** 2 × Atlas A2 (Ascend910_9382, 64 GB), CANN 9.2.1, torch 2.10.0, torch_npu 2.10.0.post7, vLLM `24420b7a`, real BF16 weights (21 shards).

**Unit tests** — 76 passed (`tests/ut/ops/test_rotary_embedding.py`). Parameterized over all four variants: checks that `CustomOp.__new__` resolves to the Ascend class, that the cache comes from the parent, that `use_mtp` is wired up, that every forward arg gets passed through, and that a signature change in the upstream `__init__` will break the build.

**Serving checks** — 13/13 on TP=2 with real weights:

| check | result |
| --- | --- |
| models endpoint | 200 |
| completions, EN + ZH | 200, non-empty |
| greedy reproducible, EN + ZH | token-identical across runs |
| seeded sampling reproducible | identical |
| different seeds diverge | yes |
| 3-turn chat, recall from turn 1 | recalled |
| turn 3 in Chinese | correct |
| retrieval, short prompt (73 tok) | found |
| retrieval, long prompt (5749 tok) | found |

`tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/test_internlm2_20b_chat.py` encodes these as two pytest cases (one `VllmRunner`, one `RemoteOpenAIServer`) — two model loads total.

**Accuracy** — C-Eval validation (52 subjects, 1346 questions, 5-shot), TP=2, ACL Graph:

```
ceval-valid | acc,none: ground_truth=0.6293 | measured=0.6337 | success=✅
1 passed in 603.84s (0:10:03)
```

Two runs: 0.6293 and 0.6337 (±0.0124 stderr). Baseline set to 0.6293.

**Performance** — numbers in the first section, `vllm bench serve`, same build with/without the registry entries.

**Lint** — `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean on the full tree; `codespell` + `markdownlint` clean on new files.

### Checklist

- [x] Four scaled RoPE variants registered and dispatch verified on NPU; three excluded variants confirmed on reference path
- [x] Unit tests for registration, cache inheritance, `use_mtp`, argument forwarding, upstream signature stability
- [x] Two-card E2E tests: offline + online, multi-turn, greedy/sampled, EN/ZH, short/long context
- [x] Accuracy config + nightly group + weight download entry
- [x] Deployment tutorial + supported-models row
- [x] Release note fragment

---

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

issues.title: [Feature][SpecDecode] Add LiLiCorr integration for Ascend
issues.body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Fix two runtime compatibility gaps encountered with text-only LiLiCorr/DFlash drafts on Ascend:

- Remove inherited `mrope_section` from `rope_parameters` / `rope_scaling` for configurations carrying a `dflash_config` dictionary and a `DraftModel` architecture. These drafts consume text positions; inherited multimodal RoPE metadata can select an inappropriate rotary path. The target configuration is not modified by this helper.
- Supply an explicit split-fuse mask to the paged FIA path when the existing mask is absent and there are more query tokens than request entries. On affected runtime stacks, multi-query draft/verify execution otherwise fails with FIA tiling error 561103 / EZ1008.

Current reviewed head: `b309131744e0e042c7d876e8aada90a694b97c78`; two production files, +39/-1. This diff does not add the LiLiCorr model, lattice-attention shim, grouped-convolution implementation, or a new graph environment variable.

### Does this PR introduce any user-facing change?

Text-only draft configurations receive RoPE normalization, and affected multi-query FIA calls receive a missing mask. The mask fallback is shared attention code and is not LiLiCorr-exclusive. Its condition does not fire for a one-query-token-per-request decode batch. Compatibility and numerical behavior of other multi-query users remain relevant regression coverage.

### How was this patch tested?

The following are archived task-53 measurements, transcribed into this description; they were not rerun during this description update. The archive's current performance section associates the results with this PR head. Historical implementation snapshots and runtime stacks differ, so the tables below must not be treated as one combined experiment or proof of every current-main configuration.

#### Performance: Qwen3.8-27B + LiLiCorr, K=7

Ascend A3, TP2 (two dies), vLLM 0.32 daily build with an Ascend main snapshot; target `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, draft eager. Workload: math500, output length 2048, `vllm bench serve --dataset-name spec_bench`, 4*C requests per concurrency point. These are single archived runs, not repeated-trial confidence intervals.

| Concurrency | AR output throughput (tok/s) | LiLiCorr output throughput (tok/s) | Ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 34.12 | 72.75 | 2.13x |
| 4 | 123.82 | 169.19 | 1.37x |
| 8 | 230.87 | 302.20 | 1.31x |

LiLiCorr TTFT was not collected for these runs; no TTFT improvement is claimed. The archive's derived TPOT/acceptance-rate estimates are deliberately not presented as directly measured metrics. C2 was not measured for the speculative arm. These ratios compare complete AR and speculative serving configurations, not the isolated speedup of either bug-fix hunk.

#### Accuracy: full C-Eval validation set

Separate compatibility-stack experiment: Qwen3.8-27B, TP2, eager, vLLM 0.31 source tree with an Ascend main snapshot. Both arms use the same fixed 1,346-question sample file, 5-shot examples from dev, answer-letter-only prompting, thinking disabled, temperature=0, top_p=1, max_tokens=128, concurrency 64.

| Configuration | Correct / total | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| AR | 1099 / 1346 | 81.65% |
| LiLiCorr K=7 | 1103 / 1346 | 81.95% |
| Difference | +4 | +0.30 percentage points |

Answer letters agree on 1333/1346 questions (99.03%). Of 13 disagreements, LiLiCorr alone is correct on 6, AR alone on 2, and both are wrong on 5; neither arm has an unparsable answer. This run shows no aggregate C-Eval score decrease, but does not establish exact token equivalence, distributional equivalence, or statistically significant accuracy improvement.

Historical coverage also includes a separate Bolt-74B A3 TP4 run: 1.30x throughput at C1 but 0.73x at C8. Gains are workload- and baseline-dependent, not universal.

### Dependencies and limitations

Requires compatible core LiLiCorr/DFlash support, torch-npu/CANN, and matching target/draft checkpoints. The archive does not supply an immutable core SHA for the 0.32 daily-build performance runtime; precise reconstruction remains limited by that missing build identity. The C-Eval runtime is different from the performance runtime and is not a fresh validation of the current rebased head.

Historical ablation found that a newer runtime could serve without the earlier fallbacks. Applicability depends on the specific runtime; successful inference alone does not establish that both changes are necessary on every current stack. No blanket claim of zero impact on other models is made.

AI assistance was used to inspect the current diff and reconcile the archived measurements for this description.

- Core reference used in the existing PR metadata (not asserted to be the measured daily-build SHA): https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

issues.title: [Model] Add MiniCPM3-4B support on Ascend (A2, BF16, TP1)
issues.body: ## 目的 为 **openbmb/MiniCPM3-4B** 补齐 Ascend 使能材料。该模型为 62 层 / 隐藏维度 2560 的稠密模型，采用 MLA 注意力、SwiGLU MLP 和 LongRoPE（4B 参数，理论上下文 32K）。 上游 vLLM 已内置 `MiniCPM3ForCausalLM`（注意力、权重映射、采样集成、LongRoPE 处理），因此**无需任何模型专用 kernel 或建模层补丁**。缺的是将其在 Ascend 上验收合格所需的全部材料：一份 E2E 配置、一份生成用例、一篇教程，以及支持矩阵 / 每日任务（nightly）的条目。 ## 本 PR 做了什么 | 文件 | 改动 | | --- | --- | | `tests/e2e/models/configs/MiniCPM3-4B.yaml` | 新增 E2E 配置：BF16、TP1、`max_model_len=4096`、`gpu_memory_utilization=0.8`、`enforce_eager=true`、GSM8K 参考值、生成矩阵参数 | | `tests/e2e/models/configs/accuracy.txt` | 注册 `MiniCPM3-4B.yaml`，使 nightly 精度任务覆盖该模型 | | `tests/e2e/models/test_minicpm3_generation.py` | 新增可选（opt-in）生成矩阵：离线 vs OpenAI 兼容服务的贪心一致性、种子非贪心可复现性、中英文短提示与约 2K token 长提示、多次运行的 NPU 显存增长上限、TP1/TP2 | | `docs/source/tutorials/models/MiniCPM3-4B.md` | 新增教程：支持特性、权重下载、部署、功能/精度/性能验证、限制与故障排查 | | `docs/source/user_guide/support_matrix/supported_models.md` | 新增 `MiniCPM3-4B` 行（A2，experimental） | | `mkdocs.yml` | 在导航中注册教程 | | `.github/workflows/configs/nightly_config.yaml` | 将该模型加入 nightly 精度矩阵 | | `.agents/skills/minicpm3-4b-ascend-adaptation/SKILL.md` | 新增该模型的适配经验笔记 | | `.agents/README.md` | 注册新技能 | 未改动 `vllm_ascend/` 运行时代码，未新增自定义算子。 ## 为什么配置长这样 - `--trust-remote-code` 是**必需的**：checkpoint 自带 `configuration_minicpm.py` / `modeling_minicpm.py`。 - `--dtype bfloat16`：checkpoint 为 BF16；FP16 与量化社区版 checkpoint 不在已验证路径内。 - `--max-model-len 4096`：保守的合格长度。`max_position_embeddings=32768` 是理论上限；32K 下的长上下文精度与显存峰值尚未验收。 - `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.8` + `--enforce-eager`：BF16 权重约 7.6 GiB。在 32 GB 卡上可为激活值留出数 GB 余量，并跳过 aclgraph 捕获（其编译/捕获阶段会同时拉高 NPU 和主机内存，使内存受限的容器不稳定）。 - lm-eval 任务中 `batch_size: 8`：lm-eval 的 `auto` 模式会持续上调 batch 直到显存耗尽，这是 32 GB 卡无法承受的。 ## 自验证报告 ### 环境 | 项目 | 版本 / 数值 | | --- | --- | | NPU | Atlas A2（910B4），单卡，32 GB HBM | | vLLM | `0.33.0rc1.dev370+empty`（源码构建 @ `24420b7a3`） | | vLLM Ascend | `0.19.1rc2.dev3339+g40b3842d3`（@ `40b3842d3`） | | torch / torch_npu | `2.10.0+cpu` / `2.10.0.post7` | | CANN | `9.0.0` | | triton-ascend | `3.6.0` | | transformers | `5.22.2` | | 模型 | `openbmb/MiniCPM3-4B`，8,148,010,378 字节，sha256 已校验 | 验证宿主机自带 CANN 9.0.0，因此 KV cache 走的是连续（contiguous）PagedAttention 布局——见「已知限制 → CANN 9.0.0 上的 block-strided GQA KV cache」。其余软件版本均与 `requirements-ascend.txt` 一致。 ### 1. 静态检查 ```text py_compile: OK yaml model_name: openbmb/MiniCPM3-4B yaml serve: {'tensor_parallel_size': 1, 'dtype': 'bfloat16', 'max_model_len': 4096, 'gpu_memory_utilization': 0.8, 'trust_remote_code': True, 'enforce_eager': True} accuracy.txt contains MiniCPM3-4B.yaml: True ``` ### 2. 服务 + 运行时探针（`vllm serve`，OpenAI 兼容 API） ```text [PASS] server reached /v1/models [PASS] GET /v1/models exposes the served name :: served=['minicpm3-4b'] [PASS] greedy completion: 'Hello, my name is' :: finish_reason=length tokens=32 [PASS] greedy completion: '人工智能的未来是' :: finish_reason=length tokens=32 [PASS] greedy is deterministic across repeated requests :: identical 32-token ids [PASS] seeded non-greedy sampling is reproducible :: 2/2 identical 32-token ids [PASS] chat completions returns non-empty content :: finish_reason=stop chars=90 [PASS] English long prompt (~2048 tokens) is answered :: prompt_tokens=2058 finish_reason=stop [PASS] Chinese long prompt (~2048 tokens) is answered :: prompt_tokens=2058 finish_reason=length [PASS] repeated generation round 1/3 stayed healthy [PASS] repeated generation round 2/3 stayed healthy [PASS] repeated generation round 3/3 stayed healthy ``` `Hello, my name is` 的贪心示例输出（32 tokens，temperature=0）： ```text 9855, 72, 1417, 1891, 1348, 5623, 22480, 1384, 32262, 16434, 59342, 1384, 1417, 1891, 2438, 1385, 6679, 1449, 1450, 1842, 4483, 1508, 10161, 1449, 1982, 1580, 72, 1417, 1580, 1348, 5997, 3138 ``` ### 3. GSM8K 精度（`test_lm_eval_correctness.py`，5-shot，chat template，batch_size=8） ```bash python -m pytest -sv tests/e2e/models \ --config tests/e2e/models/configs/MiniCPM3-4B.yaml --tp-size 1 ``` | 指标 | 配置中的门槛值 | Ascend 实测值 | | --- | --- | --- | | `exact_match,strict-match` | 0.77 | **0.7566** ✅ | | `exact_match,flexible-extract` | 0.78 | **0.7597** ✅ | 官方 model card 的 GSM8K 结果为 81.1。Ascend 实测值按仓库统一的 `test_lm_eval_correctness.py` 中 `RTOL=0.05` 进行判定，均在容差内。 ### 4. pytest 结果 | 用例 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | `test_lm_eval_correctness`（GSM8K，5-shot，chat template） | **PASSED** | | `test_minicpm3_generation.py::test_minicpm3_offline_online`（tp1） | **PASSED** | | 同一生成用例在 `--tp-size 2` 下 | SKIPPED（宿主机只有一张 NPU） | 本 PR **有意不包含**与 `transformers` 的 token 级对拍用例：checkpoint 自带的 `modeling_minicpm.py` 面向 `transformers` 4.x 的缓存/生成契约编写，在 `transformers` 5.x 下直接驱动会返回 NaN logits（`seen_tokens` / `get_max_cache_shape` / `get_usable_length` 被移除，mask 与 rotary 语义变更）。数值正确性因此改由 GSM8K 把关——它以 1319 条样本做端到端度量，远比 8 个 token 的对拍有说服力。 ## 已知限制 - **仅验证 BF16。** W8A8/W4A8、FP16 与量化社区版 checkpoint 未验证。 - **TP2 为实验性。** `num_attention_heads=40` 可被 2 整除，且已附带 TP2 E2E 用例，但尚未实际运行（验证宿主机只有单卡 NPU）。在 CI 覆盖前，支持矩阵保持 experimental。 - **32K 为理论值。** E2E 使用 4096 tokens。 - **LongRoPE 警告无害。** transformers ≥5 在归一化 checkpoint 的 `rope_scaling` 时会打印 `rope_parameters short_factor ... must have length 48, got 16`；仅在加载阶段出现，不影响外推窗口以下的生成（已在 2K 验证）。 - **无 token 级 `transformers` 对拍用例。** checkpoint 自带远程代码假设 `transformers` 4.x 的缓存与生成契约；在 5.x 下会报 `seen_tokens`、`get_max_cache_shape`、`get_usable_length` 缺失，且不带缓存直接前向会返回 NaN logits。精度改由 1319 条样本的 GSM8K 把关。 - **CANN 9.0.0 上的 block-strided GQA KV cache。** 验证使用了连续 PagedAttention KV 布局。当前 `main` 对纯 GQA 模型选择的 block-strided 布局，在此软件栈（`torch_npu==2.10.0.post7`、CANN 9.0.0、910B4）上会在首个解码步骤中于 `aclnnScatterPaKvCache` 处中止，报错 `EZ9999: Op ScatterPaKvCache has 2 uncontiguous input: keyCacheRef, valueCacheRef`——该算子在此栈上拒绝 strided 输入。本版本官方支持的软件栈钉定 CANN 9.2.1，非连续路径预计在那里可以工作；宿主机无法提供该组合，**合并前必须在官方 CANN 上复核**。本 PR 未包含针对此问题的 `vllm_ascend/` 代码改动。 ## 检查清单 - [x] 已新增模型 E2E 配置并注册进 `accuracy.txt` - [x] 已新增生成 / 离线-在线一致性测试 - [x] 已新增教程并链接进 `mkdocs.yml` - [x] 已新增支持矩阵行 - [x] 已更新 nightly 精度配置 - [x] 已在真实硬件上验证：serve + OpenAI API 探针 + GSM8K - [ ] TP2 已在 CI 中验证 - vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58
